policy: read and hook only, in probes only (bridge/build.py --mem), plus ONE code patch: the no-draw patch (bridge/build.py --no-draw; 5 bytes, site no_draw of the sites file: the game's only view / present call becomes the 5-byte nop, put on after the battle starts, removed at the battle's end; bridge/lua/apps/battle/no_draw.lua). The no-draw patch is allowed for (i) probes and lanes (scripted both sides) and (ii) battles driven by our network that are NOT exams (twin checks, technical runs: nn-arena --own-ai net only under lock-step, its default); and for nn-arena --own-ai ai. Off by default everywhere; never in the owner's own battle (human) nor in anything the owner watches; the game is never left to the owner with the call patched out (the launcher kills its game if the restore is not confirmed). Exams: none - a stage's exam in the game runs without memreader. Decided 23.11.2026 by the coordinator (the owner's word 23.11.2026: decide yourself). Explicit review required for updates
